notes: Vita3K content path default changed. Custom path can still be set in Vita3K settings.

Eden is a yuzu fork with its own user folder. It does not read yuzu's saves. Copy the save folder across, then check each game's save in Eden (right-click > Open Save Data Location). Saves not tied to a profile can become unreadable, so back up first.

Azahar uses its own user folder. On first launch it offers to copy Citra's data; if you accepted, both folders exist and that is expected. 3DS saves live under sdmc. Merge into Azahar's folder rather than replacing it.
Lime3DS became Azahar and moved its user folder. On first launch Azahar offers to migrate; if you accepted, both folders exist and that is expected.

trigger: Switching from yuzu to Eden (Linux, Steam Deck)
notes: Eden is a yuzu fork with its own user folder (~/.local/share/eden). It does not read yuzu's saves. Copy the save folder across, then check each game's save in Eden. Back up first. Flatpak installs keep data under ~/.var/app/ instead and aren't checked yet.

trigger: Switching from Citra to Azahar (Linux, Steam Deck)
notes: Azahar uses its own user folder (~/.local/share/azahar-emu). On first launch it offers to copy Citra's data; if you accepted, both folders exist and that is expected. Merge into Azahar's folder rather than replacing it. Flatpak installs keep data under ~/.var/app/ instead and aren't checked yet.

trigger: Switching from Lime3DS to Azahar (Linux, Steam Deck)
notes: Lime3DS became Azahar and moved its user folder to ~/.local/share/azahar-emu. On first launch Azahar offers to migrate; if you accepted, both folders exist and that is expected. Flatpak installs keep data under ~/.var/app/ instead and aren't checked yet.
